svg.title: Speed-up of every benchmark case
svg.desc: Bars: PostgreSQL time over pg_sift time for each case, grouped by family.
svg.text: 70 cases of query shapes: pg_sift against PostgreSQL on the same rows
PostgreSQL's median time over pg_sift's, 1,000,000 orders, one backend, logarithmic axis. Blue: faster, orange: slower. Gray: the
planner kept PostgreSQL's plan (the bar shows the cost of deciding, if any).

rect.title: topn_six_keys: PostgreSQL 104 ms, pg_sift 104 ms (1.00×) (same plan)
topn_many_keys: PostgreSQL 101 ms, pg_sift 102 ms (1.00×) (same plan)
topn_sorted_runs_btree: PostgreSQL 0.155 ms, pg_sift 0.192 ms (0.81×) (same plan)
numeric_sum: PostgreSQL 140 ms, pg_sift 139 ms (1.0×) (same plan)
